decision_basis: Parent explicitly resolved the missing numerical convention before any convolution result: Gauss-Legendre birth-time orders 8/16/32 on [0,T], max observable relative change 16 to 32 <=3e-6. No physical model change.
scope: Same fixed-bath and direct-born 10-1000 eV source scope as CONTRACT.json

birth_time_rule.refinement_metric: max relative difference of nonzero integrated active N/E, secondary ionic/excitation counts, binding/excitation energy, Coulomb heat, cutoff N/E; zero-zero pairs have difference zero

grid_metric: max absolute difference of integrated energy channels divided by total selected injected electron energy
kernel_time_validation: Reuse unchanged P02B stored-history checks at 1e11 s and 2e-4 threshold; no full kernel suite rerun
cohort_clock: age=T-t_birth >=0; immutable P02B deterministic stage schedule; no negative-age extrapolation
first_attempt_design: At grid512, birth orders8/16/32; at grids128/256, birth order32. Evolve source64/source96 as two linear columns through identical cohort stages. Observe each column on its own age-dependent characteristic grid before summation.
